root_cause: The Windows Release build completed fully (configure, compile, install, packaging, JS/node package build, uploads all succeeded) but the final 'Store artifacts to a shared drive' step, which copies openvino_package.zip, developer_package.zip, openvino_tests.zip, manifest.yml, openvino_js_package.zip, openvino_node_npm_package.zip, and wheels to the network-mounted share at C:\mount\build-artifacts, failed every copy with WinError 112 ('There is not enough space on the disk'). This is the second occurrence of this exact signature within ~13 minutes (the first was on the Debug variant of the same PR's merge-queue run, 41923823854), confirming the shared artifact storage volume is at/over capacity rather than this being a one-off blip. PR #39101 only touches GitHub Actions workflow YAML/JS for GenAI/LLM wheel installation and does not affect the Windows build or store_artifacts action, so the PR's own changes are not implicated.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; requires the shared CI storage volume (C:\mount\build-artifacts) to be at capacity. Check disk usage/quota of the `build-artifacts` share around 2026-11-04T23:08-23:11 UTC and look for cleanup/retention jobs for old commit artifacts.
recommended_actions: Check and free up space on the C:\mount\build-artifacts shared drive (Windows CI artifact storage volume) or increase its quota/capacity as a priority - this is now a recurring failure within the same hour
Verify/trigger the artifact retention/cleanup job for old commit directories under dldt/master/commit/* on that share
Re-run the failed Build job (handled automatically via remediate_transient_failure) once storage space is confirmed available - this PR's own changes are not implicated
Add disk-space pre-check or alerting on the shared artifact storage to catch near-full conditions before jobs fail, since this is the second hit in 13 minutes
prevention_strategies: Add proactive monitoring/alerting on the shared artifact storage volume's free space with a threshold alert well before 100% full, and an automated retention policy that prunes old per-commit artifact directories so the share does not silently fill up and fail unrelated builds repeatedly.
historical_context: Same signature (disk-full WinError 112 on the shared artifact drive, pattern 32d3435950a13f58) was recorded 13 minutes earlier for the Debug variant build of the same merge-queue run batch (run 41923823854, PR #39101). This is the 2nd occurrence; escalation threshold is 3+ in 12 hours, so notify_teams_recurring is not yet triggered but the recurrence is noted for awareness.
